ruleDefinitions.name: File Encryption Using Gpg4win
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of Gpg4win to encrypt files

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\gpg\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\gpg2\\\.exe$")) OR process_description = "GnuPG’s\ OpenPGP\ tool") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*passphrase.*")))
